clinical_context: Pathogen-directed anti-Toxoplasma therapy is indicated for suspected or confirmed cerebral toxoplasmosis in the appropriate clinical setting and should not await biopsy or organism confirmation when clinical suspicion is sufficient.
contraindication_notes: Regimen selection requires review of allergy cytopenia risk organ function pregnancy and medication availability.
board_exam_pearl: Clinical response supports reassessment but does not by itself prove the diagnosis.
notes: Assess clinical and radiologic response; lack of expected improvement should prompt reconsideration of competing diagnoses and possible further evaluation.
patient_stability: Stabilize seizures declining consciousness and mass-effect concern while initiating disease-directed management.
hepatic_context: review hepatic function and drug interactions
prerequisite_actions: Obtain urgent neuroimaging and assess safety before invasive diagnostic procedures when mass effect is possible.
monitoring: Monitor symptoms neurologic examination blood counts organ function and radiologic response; maintenance and immune-status management are individualized.
subject_exams: Neurology; Internal Medicine; Infectious Disease; Emergency Medicine
